summary: Develop capability maps, architecture views, and transition roadmaps. Explore TOGAF and ArchiMate in practical five-day training. Enquire today.
lede: Enterprise architecture connects business capabilities, information, applications, and technology to support coordinated change. For enterprise architects, business analysts, and IT leaders, the course provides practice mapping capabilities, assessing application portfolios, and turning dependencies into a prioritized transition roadmap. Workshops also cover stakeholder viewpoints, architecture decisions, governance, cloud considerations, and conceptual AI-assisted portfolio classification.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape business and technology change and need to connect architecture choices to organizational priorities.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Experience in a business, IT, architecture, analysis, or transformation role; familiarity with organizational processes and information systems is useful. No programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel and PowerPoint access for template-based exercises. Advanced topics, including AI-assisted portfolio analysis, are covered at conceptual awareness level.
